name: com.voiceassistants/voice-gateway
title: VoiceAssistants
description: Find local US and Canadian businesses: verified hours, phone, services, prices and answers to say.

tools.name: find_businesses
tools.description: Search the VoiceAssistants directory of local US businesses by what the person needs (a trade such as "plumber", a service such as "drain cleaning", or a business name) and where (city and two-letter state). Optional filters: open right now, available today, or a maximum starting price in US dollars. Returns up to `limit` businesses, each with an `id` to pass to get_business, get_hours or answer_question. If nothing matches exactly, the search is widened and `relaxed` says how. Results are ordered by how recently each business was verified, never by payment. Read `spoken` aloud as the answer.

query.description: What is needed: a trade ("plumber"), a service ("AC repair") or a business name. Plain words.

state.description: Two-letter US state code, for example "FL".

open_now.description: Only businesses open at this moment in their own time zone.

available_today.description: Only businesses that have confirmed today that they can take new work today.

max_starting_price.description: Only businesses with a published starting price at or below this many US dollars.

tools.name: get_business
tools.description: Get the facts on file for one business in the VoiceAssistants directory: what it is, where, phone, hours, and — for a premium listing — services with supplied prices, service area, credentials and live availability. Every fact comes from the business; `source` and `last_verified` say where and when. Pass the `id` from find_businesses. Read `spoken` aloud.

id.description: The business id from find_businesses, for example "seaside-plumbing-stuart-fl".

tools.name: get_hours
tools.description: Answer "is it open now?", "when does it close?" and "is it open on Thanksgiving?" for one business in the VoiceAssistants directory. Returns whether it is open at this moment in its own time zone, today's hours, the full week, and any holiday hours on file. If the business has no hours on file it says so rather than guessing. Pass the `id` from find_businesses. Read `spoken` aloud.

tools.name: answer_question
tools.description: Answer a specific question about one business in the VoiceAssistants directory — for example "do they take emergency calls?", "are they licensed?", "do they serve Palm City?", "how much is a drain cleaning?" — from the answers on file for it. Answers are the business's own, or restate a fact it supplied; nothing is guessed. If the answer is not on file, `answered` is false and `spoken` says so and gives the phone number. Pass the `id` from find_businesses. Read `spoken` aloud.

question.description: The question, in the person's own words.

tools.name: request_callback
tools.description: Ask one business in the VoiceAssistants directory to call the person back. This sends the person's name and phone number to that business. BEFORE calling this tool, say the business's name and the phone number back to the person and get a clear yes; then set `consent` to true. Only some businesses take callback requests — if this one does not, the result says so and gives its phone number instead. Read `spoken` aloud.

name.description: The person's name, as they want the business to address them.

phone.description: The phone number the business should call, with area code.

consent.description: Must be true: the person has just confirmed, in this conversation, that they want this business to contact them at this number.

note.description: Optional: what the call is about, in a sentence.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Send one business in the VoiceAssistants directory a request for a price quote: what the job is, when the person would like it done, and how to reach them. This sends the person's name, phone number and the job details to that business. BEFORE calling this tool, read the business's name, the job and the phone number back to the person and get a clear yes; then set `consent` to true. Only some businesses take quote requests — if this one does not, the result says so and gives its phone number instead. Read `spoken` aloud.

name.description: The person's name, as they want the business to address them.

phone.description: The phone number the business should call, with area code.

consent.description: Must be true: the person has just confirmed, in this conversation, that they want this business to contact them at this number.

service.description: The service wanted, for example "water heater replacement".

details.description: The job in the person's own words: what is wrong or what they want done.

preferred_time.description: Optional: when they would like the work done, for example "this week" or "Saturday morning".
